walkthroughs.body_html:
Revenue = price × quantity sold.

If you sell 50 cookies at £2 each, revenue = £100. 🍪

Revenue is the top line — everything starts here.

Two kinds of cost:

  • Fixed — rent, insurance. Same each month.
  • Variable — flour, sugar, electricity. They rise as you make more.

Total costs = fixed + variable.

The big formula:

Profit = Revenue − Costs

Revenue £100 − Costs £60 = Profit £40. 🎉

If costs are bigger than revenue, you make a loss.
